name: Clause-Based Bipartite Obfuscation
description: I replaced the algebraic transformation with a pair of redundancy conditions ("at least one endpoint must be state 1" and "at least one must be state 2"). This is logically identical to requiring different states (bipartite coloring), but perfectly mimics the phrasing of a 2-SAT problem. Models relying on surface pattern matching may misclassify it as a generic 2-SAT instance and struggle with the lexicographically smallest requirement (which is NP-hard for general 2-SAT), while models that genuinely reason will recognize it simplifies to simple graph 2-coloring.
